functions: every output-capable GPIO lists the GPIO-matrix signals spi2/spi3 (HSPI/VSPI), uart0–2, i2c0–1, i2s0–1, can0 (TWAI); the input-only GPIOs only their input signals; adc1/adc2 = the ADC unit (ADC1_CHn, ADC2_CHn in table 3) – the channel is not in the function name
functions: no pwm – LEDC (16 channels, 8 timers) and MCPWM reach every GPIO through the matrix, which edakit's slice model cannot express (see verified.open)
adc.range_v [0.15, 2.45]: the effective range at attenuation 3 (table 11) – assumption: the firmware uses attenuation 3; atten 0/1/2 read 100–950 / 100–1250 / 150–1750 mV
i_core_a 0.379 A: the 802.11b TX peak of table 16 as the upper bound (average 239 mA at 100 % duty cycle)

gpio_i_max_a 0.028 A: IOL typ 28 mA at VOL 0.495 V and maximum drive strength (table 15; IOH typ 40 mA, falling to about 29 mA per pin as more pins source current) – assumption: the datasheet gives no absolute maximum per pin
pin v_max_v and gpio_v_max_v 3.6 V: VIH max VDD + 0.3 V at VDD 3.3 V (table 15); the module datasheet gives no absolute maximum for IO pins

antenna.keepout_mm: the antenna area of figure 13 (6.19 mm × 18 mm at the module's antenna end) placed in the EasyEDA footprint WIFI-SMD_ESP32-WROOM-32E (pin 1 at x = –9.0 mm, the antenna end towards –x, module edge at x = –16.49 mm, silk at –16.48 mm)

ESP32 Series Datasheet v5.3, 4.8 Peripheral Pin Configurations: the pins for UART, regular I2C, the I2S Controller, the LED PWM Controller, Motor Control PWM and the Two-wire Automotive Interface (TWAI) can be chosen from any GPIOs via the GPIO Matrix; SPI (HSPI, VSPI) is multiplexed via the IO MUX (4.8.2) – left to the pins' functions

antenna.edge_mm 1: Espressif ESP32 Hardware Design Guidelines, release master (26 October 2026), 1.4.8 Positioning a Module on a Base Board, p. 27–29: the PCB antenna outside the base board, the feed point close to its edge; figure 25 (read from the graph): the board's edge at most 1 mm beyond the antenna area's outer side ('Max 1'), at most 2 mm beyond the module's side, the board cut away at least 15 mm beside the antenna – https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-hardware-design-guidelines/en/latest/esp32/esp-hardware-design-guidelines-en-master-esp32.pdf, read 2026-10-31; the 15 mm beside an antenna in a cut-out and inside the housing are not a field (the pcb reviewer asks, domain radio)
notes: Bare ESP32 module without regulator (3V3 supplied from outside). functions holds no pwm on purpose: the GPIO matrix routes LEDC/MCPWM to any GPIO, which the slice model of REQ.function cannot express – a net with fn pwm on this module is reported by REQ.function until the schema can say 'any channel through the matrix'.
